facts.note: The smallest place the size-class ladder admits. A gym whose small end is bigger than this is not showing the walker the bound they are being asked about.
The largest. The distance between this number and the one above it is the whole ladder, and the walk is the argument about whether it has the right number of rungs.
Where both climbs land, and the lip the designed fall goes over: the drop policy's cap above grade, so one plane demonstrates three standards.
